title: Scan {{mode}}
noCamera: The camera is not available. Choose a photo from your gallery instead.
comingSoon: {{mode}} scanning is coming soon. Product, Plate and Ingredients scanning work now.

hint.product: Point at a barcode or label
hint.receipt: Fit the whole receipt in the frame
hint.ingredients: Spread items out on the counter

guide.receipt: Hold the phone about 20 cm above the receipt so its edges touch the guide.

detail.product: Adds it to your pantry with its best-before date.
detail.receipt: Adds every item from your shop in one go.
detail.plate: Lists its ingredients so you can add what you are missing to your shopping list.
detail.ingredients: Adds each loose item on the counter to your pantry.
